decisions.reason: As a multi-model handle family in the core range, it still benefits from sunk development and portfolio-breadth logic, so despite its lower recent visibility management would more likely keep it than admit a delayed misstep.

This design is less strategically central and easier to prune than a full family, but after several years on the market management can still justify keeping it as a normal range item rather than reversing course.

Because this handle family supports the firm's broad established offering and embodies more committed resources than a single design, escalation of commitment points to continued support unless performance is clearly untenable.

As the flagship electronic access system tied to the firm's stated digital direction and public claims, it carries the strongest strategic and reputational commitment, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
